_help: Settings for the siege map. Edit the values, keep the quotes and commas. Every setting is explained in config/README.md. If the map shows 'Settings file has a mistake', check for a missing comma or quote near the line it names.

text.title: Sieges of the
text.intro: Every town, castle, church and great house besieged in the wars of the three kingdoms. Pick a story, a year or a side, then click a siege to read about it.
text.footer: Data: Stephen Charnock and National Civil War Centre, Newark. Dates are Old Style (Julian calendar), with the year taken to begin on 1 January rather than 25 March; “approx.” durations are the source's estimates.
text.startHereButton: New here? The story of the wars
text.storiesIntro: A story picks out the sieges that share a thread: how they ended, a campaign, a commander, a theme. Choose one and the map shows only those sieges, with an account of what links them. Then follow the story to visit each siege in turn.

github._help: Where the project lives on GitHub. The data checker uses this to list the photos folder.

dates._help: How dates are written in the spreadsheet: 'year-first' (1644/7/2), 'day-first' (2/7/1644) or 'auto' to accept both.

help_help: The 'How to use this map' guide: one step per part of the page. 'target' is the part to point at (#map, #storiesBox, #hist, #sides, #sizeToggle, #search, #resetAll); add, remove, reorder or reword freely.

help.title: The map
help.text: Each circle is a siege, coloured by the side that prevailed: blue for Parliament, red for the Royalists, yellow for the Scots. A number means several sieges at one place. Click a circle to read about it, and zoom in to see the names.

help.title: Stories
help.text: Open Stories to pick a thread: how sieges ended, a campaign, a commander or a theme. The map shows only those sieges, with an account of what links them, and Follow the story takes you through them one at a time.

help.title: Sieges begun, by year
help.text: Click a year to see only the sieges that began then, or press Play to watch the wars unfold year by year.

help.title: Who prevailed
help.text: Untick a side to hide the sieges it won. Underneath, you can size the circles by how long each siege lasted.

help.title: Find a siege
help.text: Search for a place or a county, or sort the list by length, date or name. Click any entry to fly to it on the map.

help.title: Show all sieges
help.text: Clears every story, year, side and search and takes you back to the whole map. It stays at the top of the panel as you scroll.

tours._help: How a story's tour looks. Each story picks 'visit' or 'route' in the Tour column of data/stories.csv; 'default' is used when that column is empty. The fade settings run from 0 (invisible) to 1 (full strength).

stories_help: Stories now come from data/stories.csv (see config/README.md). This list is only used if data.stories is removed.
